messages.subject: Mixed effect model with weights
parts:
HI INLA Members,

I have a question in mixed effect model.

Generally mixed effect model can be written as 

\eta = X \beta + Z \mathbf{u}.

where X is the covariates and \mathbf{u} is the random effect part.

In INLA,

the way to introduce weights in latent process is 

f( \mathbf{u} , weight , model="..." )

Now can we interpret Z as a diagonal matrix with  diagonal elements as weight in INLA?

Alokesh.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Mixed effect model with weights
parts:
there is a model, 'z' for this purpose, please check

inla.doc("^z")
